verification_policy: Batched readability workflow: exact token substitution for alpha-only edits; review event routing, callback order and live/cached reads for structured edits. One target build. Native comparisons reserved for uncertain behavior; reccmp refresh deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability reconstruction of existing Mirage card handlers and local helpers. No new native-function coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim. Preserve unusual native behavior, repeated queries, context checks and opaque dialogs.
review_notes: Thirty-four alpha-only definitions preserve exact tokens after declared local renames. Twenty-seven structured definitions use source review and one target build; no new native semantic comparisons.
Keep phasing eligibility, recursive attachment order, repeated card-ID queries, cached host/own state and indirect phasing/detachment rules.
Keep Acidic Dagger's stored-target fields and native counter behavior, Celestial Dawn's repeated queries, cost conversion and off-battlefield color refresh behavior.
Keep aura eligibility, humiliation gates, trigger order, fresh/cached attachment context, flash expiry, protection selection, life changes and opaque dialogs.
Keep sacrifice scoring thresholds and the complete two card-ID bonus groups. Preserve sacrifice/payment outcomes, mana filtering and fresh fizzle/context reads.
Keep Builder's Bane's cast/retarget preview, free/token routes, native human/AI X behavior, signed target limits, destruction/life-loss order and cached damage amount across callbacks.
status: Applied readability batch. One target build and coverage receipt follow; reccmp refresh is deferred to a larger checkpoint.
